PendingDecision.description: One row of the maintainer pending queue: a decision at `status: proposed`.

age_days.description: Signed whole days between the decision's `date:` frontmatter and today; negative when the date lies in the future.

changed_since_review.description: True when any comparable review receipt hash differs from the current subject hash; receipts without a comparable hash never set it.

evidence.description: Review evidence for a local-tier decision.

ratification.description: Parsed ratification tier; absent frontmatter defaults to `binding`.

refined_by.description: Decisions that refine this pending decision.

reopen_command.description: Exact command that reproduces this briefing in full.

rubric.description: Decision rubric, when the body carries a rubric heading.

ruling_prompt.description: Plain instruction for ruling on this decision in the session.

subject_hash.description: Current subject manifest for local-tier decisions, when it can be computed.

subject_hash_error.description: Manifest construction failure for local-tier decisions, when one occurs.

superseded_by.description: Decisions that supersede this pending decision.

PendingDecisionEdge.description: One reverse provenance edge carried by a pending decision briefing.

PendingEvidence.description: Evidence state for a local-tier pending decision.

receipts.description: Review stems named by the decision or linked through `affects:`.

PendingReceipt.description: One review receipt attached to a local-tier pending decision.

reviewer.description: Reviewer name, when the review artefact is present.

stem.description: Review stem from the decision's `receipts:` list or an `affects:` rule (exact review files even when absent; directories via loaded reviews).

subject_hash_matches.description: Whether this review covered the decision's current subject manifest; null when either hash is unavailable, so no comparison was made.

verdict.description: First line under the review's Verdict heading, when present.

PendingRubric.description: The four named parts of a decision rubric.

alignment.description: How the decision fits the project mission.

tier.description: Decision tier and its supporting facts.

PendingTier.description: Wire form of the ratification tier, constrained in the committed schema.

description: Wire shape of the `pending` query response.

pending.description: Proposed decisions, oldest first (age descending, ties by id ascending).
